rows.recovery: Edit → local applied → queue captured revision → serverack → mark that revision only. Newer edits remain pending. Offline queue as actually supported, otherwise explicit local only. Recovery offer preview/backup → Keep changes(local dismiss)or Reload latest guard → reconcile. Conflict Reload latest/Save backup/Overwrite as eligible; Overwrite CAS recheck and impact, not blanket remote-reset. Closing dialog keeps conflict status. Backup failure must not discard local recovery or trigger reload. Separate Download backup from an explicit Continue to reload: successful generation/download initiation is labelled “Download started”, not proof that a file was retained. On serialization/download-initiation failure retain conflict, local recovery and draft; offer Retry/Cancel. Reload requires deliberate confirmation and current-revision checks. This corrects the source-only risk in ConflictModal and AquibraStudio, whose current finally path can reload after backup failure.

rows.feature: **Image loss after failed asset registration (10-14 P0)**
rows.current_description: If the upload or `createAsset` fails, the asset stays device-only with a `blob:` src. The element is placed, but every server save strips session URLs, so the server copy of the page has no `src`. A reload (or another device) before the retry succeeds shows an empty image. The retry remap (`LOCAL_URLS_REBUILT`) can only re-point elements that still hold the `blob:`, and the persisted page no longer does.

rows.recovery: Edit → local applied → queue captured revision → serverack → mark that revision only. Newer edits remain pending. Offline queue as actually supported, otherwise explicit local only. Recovery offer preview/backup → Keep changes(local dismiss)or Reload latest guard → reconcile. Conflict Reload latest/Save backup/Overwrite as eligible; Overwrite CAS recheck and impact, not blanket remote-reset. Closing dialog keeps conflict status.
